title: GTA6 Introduces Headphones and Podcasts for On-the-Go Listening
description: For the first time in the series, GTA6 will let players listen to radio stations and new on-demand podcasts on foot using connected headphones.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Revolutionizes Audio Immersion with Headphones and Podcasts

As anticipation builds for the next installment in Rockstar Games' blockbuster franchise, new details regarding the gameplay experience of Grand Theft Auto 6 have emerged. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, GTA6 will, for the first time in the series, allow players to listen to radio stations while not inside a vehicle by utilizing headphones and earbuds connected to in-game smartphones.

### Breaking the Limits of Vehicle-Only Radios

In previous titles of the Grand Theft Auto series, enjoying the meticulously curated radio stations, satirical commercials, and eccentric talk shows was strictly tied to being inside a car, bike, or other mode of transportation. Once players stepped out onto the sidewalk, the immersive musical background would fade away. Eurogamer's report indicates that GTA6 is set to change this long-standing mechanic, giving players the freedom to keep the tunes and talk shows rolling while exploring the open world on foot.

### Introducing On-Demand Podcasts

In addition to traditional radio stations, the upcoming game will also introduce on-demand podcasts. This modern feature allows players to dive into episodic audio content while navigating the game's criminal underworld. It adds another layer of contemporary satire and world-building, ensuring that the entertainment options reflect the realities of modern media consumption.

## Editor's Take
By allowing players to tune into radio stations and podcasts via in-game headphones while outside of vehicles, Rockstar Games is significantly enhancing the immersion of open-world exploration. This thoughtful addition ensures that the game's exceptional audio design and cultural satire are never more than a click away, no matter how you choose to travel across the map.
